releases.notes:
## 🔧 Core Update
- **Ported to Minecraft 26.1+**

## ✨ New Features
- **Auto flip direction** — switches UP/DOWN automatically when dragged to a corner (requires Guides ON); label pulses before flipping
- **New alignment option** — CENTER keeps subtitles fixed, AUTO shifts them toward the nearest screen edge
- **BG Opacity slider** — now controls real subtitle background opacity
- **Preview modes** — cycle between OFF, Outline only, and Full preview
- **Subtitle Limit** — set a max number of subtitles shown at once; placeholder rows preview the limit visually
- **Sound Blacklist** — block specific subtitles from appearing; type to search with auto-suggestions from Minecraft's subtitle list

## 🎨 UI & Visual
- Buttons auto-hide while dragging for a cleaner view
- Redesigned corner handle — L-shaped
- Redesigned and Improved vanilla background — to match vanilla Minecraft style
- Preview box redesigned — removed the solid black background for a subtle outline
